personality: 6 Glass / Luxe fused with 7 Dark-First Utility for data density
personality_one_liner: A $10,000+ premium prop firm scaling terminal where luxury glassmorphism meets high-density trading operations.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room but tight grouping for data rows. Use padding to create depth instead of just borders.

do's: Use blur on bottom tabs, sticky headers, and floating FABs.
Pair glass panels with a translucent tint (≥75% opacity) to ensure readability.
Apply subtle neon glow (`success` or `brandPrimary`) behind premium featured cards.
dont's: Never blur body text or dense form regions.
Avoid stacking more than two blur layers on a single screen.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center overview: Cumulative payout progress, Win rate, and active Copy Trading Master status.

states.loading: Dark skeleton loaders pulsing with electric blue tint.
states.empty: Premium empty state pushing the user to link their first eval account.
states.error: Soft red warning text with a retry connection button.

screens.layout: Top sticky glass header with User Profile/Level. Hero section: Large Animated Progress Wheel ($50K Goal Tracker) with Gold accents. Grid of 2x2 KPI cards below it (Win Rate, Overall R). Bottom section: Quick roadmap scaling visual (25K -> 50K -> etc.).

screens.name: Account Control Center
screens.purpose: Manage all trading accounts (Evaluations, Funded, Copy Trade Slaves) in a dense, color-coded table.

states.empty: Dark abstract illustration (boxes/grid) saying 'No active accounts connected'.
states.error: Error fetching account status from broker API.

screens.layout: Sticky filter row (All, Eval, Funded, Blown) using pill tabs. List view of accounts: Premium rounded cards. Profitable accounts have a subtle neon green glow on the card border. Blown accounts use a muted dark panel with a soft red status tag. Live accounts have a pulsing dot indicator.

screens.name: Planner
screens.purpose: 90-day execution calendar and daily trading checklists.
screens.layout: Horizontal scrollable week/month view at the top. Below: A structured daily checklist (Pre-market prep, Risk limit check, End-of-day review). Completed items trigger a subtle haptic success strike-through.

screens.name: Journal & Analytics
screens.purpose: Log trades, upload screenshots, and view performance charts.
screens.layout: Two-tab toggle at top (Log Trade | Analytics). Log Trade: Single-column form with screenshot upload area. Analytics: Dark-themed charts (Account Growth Line Chart, R-Distribution Bar Chart). Smooth animated chart loading sequences.

login_hero_bg.alt: Abstract dark glowing blue particles for premium fintech login background

badge_gold_elite.alt: Luxury gold abstract lines representing an elite milestone badge

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for a premium $10,000+ fintech SaaS/Bloomberg Terminal aesthetic. It MUST feel like an elite command center, not a standard consumer app.

Implement 'Neon Green' (#00FF66) glows via box-shadow or Skia solely around profitable/funded accounts, and 'Soft Red' (#FF4444) for risk/drawdown. This is a trading app; green/red have literal financial meaning.
For typography, STRICTLY use 'Space Grotesk' for all numbers, metrics, and KPI readouts, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for labels and body text.

Animation Requirements: Use react-native-reanimated for Number Counters on the $50k goal tracker. Add animated entrance for cards (fade and slide up) and a live pulsing dot (scale & opacity loop) on active accounts.
Backgrounds: Use the provided `login_hero_bg` (glowing particles) behind the main Home dashboard, heavily darkened with a vertical scrim gradient (Layer 2) so text stays legible.
The 90-Day Planner must feature dense, structured layout cells rather than huge playful bubbles. Precision is key.
When building the Account Control Center, profitable accounts should have an `active` state glow (shadow color #00FF66 with low opacity/spread), while normal panels stay `surfaceSecondary`.
